items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: you were telling us about those dances when that man from New York, Marshall Stearns, was here.

ctx.x: Well, they hold a dress, you know, and it's just their foot, and they had the horse, jarboun. That's what they made the music out of. Oh, yes.

Uh-huh. Well, last fall, you were telling us about those dances when that man from New York, Marshall Stearns, was here. And you mentioned you'd seen some dances in the old Congo Square. What kind of dances did they have there? On the Congo Square?
Danse Creole. Creole dance. Can you see this picture? Is there enough light here?
